title: ProfileVersion (P1 §3.4 — three-state lifecycle; M1 = Saved, not Finalized)

trigger_token.description: P2/M2: the LoRA trigger token last used at stage time (also seeds the M3 caption preview).

caption_status.description: P2/M2 stage-time caption facts: status/caption_count/caption_policy_hash/captions_hash (+ edited_count, M3).

caption_overrides.description: P2/M3 caption-edit override layer: ref_id → {caption, edited_at}. Durable on the version (survives re-staging); staging emits the edited text with origin 'edited' and captions_hash reflects it (caption_policy_hash still identifies the template).

training_context.description: P2/M2 pointer to training_context.json + its context_digest.

readiness_status.description: P2/M4 advisory readiness summary (status/recommended/on_model/computed_at) — the full tiers live in readiness.json. Never a hard gate (R14).

lora.description: P2/M6 promoted character LoRA: {file, sha256, manifest, base_family, trigger_token, lora_weight_default, promoted_at, job_id}. The full record is lora/lora.manifest.json (P2-13 graph-ready facts). Null/absent = untrained (still a valid P1 version).

anchor.description: M4 face anchor (R94): the chosen detailed-face image, copied into the version's faces/ dir (self-contained, survives job deletion). Per-version and re-pickable (scar/tattoo). Feeds the Stage-B identity-lock pass (R93: on by default once present, opt-out).

ref_set.description: Stage-C curated refs (the future LoRA corpus). Each item carries its frozen coverage_cell (P1→P2 contract, P1-16) so P2's template captioner can caption it. Promoted string→object in P1/M3 (mirrors casting[]); legacy empty ref_sets are unaffected.

style_id.description: M2.8 #7: the resolved L1 style the source cell was generated under (from the job's per-output meta) — graph-ready provenance for P2-13 training_context; null on legacy refs / style-off runs.

rejected.description: P1-12 curation throughput: out/-relative output names the author REJECTED during Stage-C culling (~100→~30). Lightweight + persistent (survives reloads) — no image copy; mutually exclusive with ref_set membership (keep wins, un-rejecting).
